# Where player-facing copy lives, for the slop scan (scan.mjs, the web vitest and the api Go test).
# "+ <path>" scans a file or a directory tree; "- <regex>" drops repo-relative paths that match.
# Only files with a copy extension are read: .ts .js .mjs .svelte .astro .md .json .go .lua.
# A file whose first five lines say "generated" or "DO NOT EDIT" is skipped as generated data.

+ web/src/lib
+ web/src/components
+ web/src/pages
+ web/src/layouts
+ web/src/content
+ apps/shared/copy
+ api/internal/refusal
+ api/internal/discordbot
+ api/internal/notify
+ api/internal/coach
+ api/internal/guilds
+ api/internal/billing
+ api/internal/billingmail
+ api/internal/digest
+ addon/ForeverSixty
+ companion/ui/copy.js
+ companion/internal/app/copy.go

# Tests, fixtures and test helpers are not copy.
- (^|/)[^/]*[._-](test|spec)\.[a-z]+$
- _test\.go$
- (^|/)(testdata|fixtures|test-support|__tests__|e2e)/
# Generated game data: item and spell names are Blizzard's, not ours.
- ^addon/ForeverSixty/Data\.lua$
# Engineering notes beside the api code are not player copy.
- ^api/.*\.md$
# The coach's LLM prompt and schema are instructions to a model, not player copy.
- ^api/internal/coach/(prompt_rules\.txt|schema\.json)$
